coaching.headline: We took both Fangtooths and led objective damage 18,881 to 253, but got caught alone nine times to their three.
coaching.team: Steel's solo death at 14.2 cost us our Outer Tower at 14.8, and the fight right after, lost 1-3, was the first game-defining swing — even though jungle and support were our two favored lanes, with carry, mid and offlane all losing theirs. The duo lane still opened well, with first blood on Dekker at minute 2, and the game held even through an 11.2 trade we won 2-1 but never converted. We took both Fangtooths, at minute 6 and minute 19, the second off an even 2-2 cross-map trade. Legion's solo death at 19.5 then opened a 4-against-5 we lost 0-2. Revenant's solo catch at 20.5 cost two towers in the minutes after. The game ended in a full wipe at 21.7, lost 0-5. We were caught alone nine times to their three; towers finished 3-3, objective damage 18,881 to 253, majors 9-14 them.

coaching.whatWorked: We secured both Fangtooths, at minute 6 and minute 19, the second converted straight off an even 2-2 trade at Fangtooth.
